producer_scope: Five fixed Enderman Overhaul cards only, no activation or independent-review receipt
standalone_contract: Ordinary integrated and dedicated logical server, no JEMServer or other producer-family dependency
config: Client/ManagedPack/config/endermanoverhaul.jsonc current native spawning and friendly behavior enabled

bounds.world_reads: Exact native bound entity ID lookup only, no entity/world scans, forced chunks or nearest-player lookup
bounds.inventory_reads: Exact native delivery arguments only, no inventory polling

preservation: No native inventory ItemStack metadata added, preserving native bound-pearl stacking and slots. Proof-only metadata is kept on actual bound/summoned/projectile entities. Every redirected native operation runs exactly once with original arguments and original return. All native damage/cost/cooldown/effects/teleport/ownership/equipment remain owned upstream
native_quirks: Native ThrownSoulPearl constructor uses the CORRUPTED_PEARL entity type. Producer targets the actual native class, not a guessed registry identity

Native CorruptedBlade checks attacker blacklist rather than target. Observer additionally rejects protected target proof, without replacing or repairing native gameplay. Existing server teleport guards remain in force
Native boundEntity is not serialized by ThrownSoulPearl, so successful runtime relocation after lost native lineage is not synthesized

producers.native_evidence: SoulPearlItem.interactLivingEntity native BoundEntity/BoundType result must actually enter the hand, inventory or accepted dropped entity before binding is recorded on that exact entity UUID for the real actor. Native use must consume one pearl and spawn the exact owned projectile with cooldown. Native ThrownSoulPearl.boundEntity must match the previously bound UUID, and its actual native teleportTo call must change the same live allowed target position. Two ordinary native criteria preserve bound and original completed action
unsupported_paths: Summoner Pearl is only related guide information and does not satisfy the fixed Soul objective
Native projectile reload loses the native boundEntity field, observer never reconstructs native mechanics
Protected/dead target, denied output insertion, failed throw or unchanged final relocation
